cross_sensor.decision_reason: A and C each keep a useful verified set; C maintains quality/spatial occupancy vs A under cross-sensor CLAHE; transforms stable
cross_sensor.decision_rule: Cross-sensor is SUPPORTED only if: (1) C uses representation_id 'cross_sensor' while A uses intensity; (2) A and C each produce verified inliers strictly above the projective DLT minimum; (3) C verified inliers and source/reference occupied cells are each at least 0.5 of A's; (4) both transforms fit from more than 4 inliers. This is cross-instrument optical robustness, not full multi-modal OHRC/TMC/IIRS validation. Independent accuracy remains NOT VALIDATED. Do not retune.
cross_sensor.maintain_reason: maintained vs A within 0.5: inliers 72->55, source cells 23->21, reference cells 14->17
cross_sensor.modality_claim: cross-instrument optical (OHRC <-> LROC NAC); not OHRC/TMC/IIRS multi-modal validation
cross_sensor.transform_reason: both variants fitted a transform from more than 4 verified inliers

demonstrated: OHRC <-> LROC NAC coarse-to-fine correspondence under native GSD gap

gsd_scale_context.note: Native GSD ratio uses ingested OHRC gsd_meters and LROC catalog 0.5 m/px when LROC ingested gsd_meters is null. This is the real cross-sensor scale gap on the overlapping pair, not a synthetic resampling factor.

limitations: Matcher-derived held-out RMSE is not ground-truth accuracy.
Raw match count is not a success criterion.
Only OHRC and LROC products exist in the current demo dataset.
LROC gsd_meters is catalog fallback 0.5 m/px, not SPICE-derived.
Parameters are not retuned after the run.
not_demonstrated: general lunar scale invariance beyond this pair/GSD pair
that resampling alone proves real lunar scale invariance

scale.decision_reason: native GSD ratio is material; A and B each keep a useful verified set; B maintains quality/spatial occupancy vs A; transforms stable
scale.decision_rule: Scale is SUPPORTED only if: (1) a finite native GSD ratio is reported from ingested OHRC gsd_meters and LROC catalog fallback 0.5 m/px and differs from 1 by more than 5%; (2) A and B each produce verified inliers strictly above the projective DLT minimum; (3) B verified inliers and source/reference occupied cells are each at least 0.5 of A's; (4) both transforms fit from more than 4 inliers; (5) B's scale_policy is common_physical_gsd and observed strides differ from A's or effective GSDs are recorded. Raw match count is not success. Independent accuracy remains NOT VALIDATED. Do not retune.
scale.maintain_reason: maintained vs A within 0.5: inliers 72->99, source cells 23->15, reference cells 14->10
scale.native_gsd_ratio_reason: native GSD ratio 0.5600 differs from 1 by more than 5%
scale.transform_reason: both variants fitted a transform from more than 4 verified inliers

multimodal_decision_rule: Cross-sensor is SUPPORTED only if: (1) C uses representation_id 'cross_sensor' while A uses intensity; (2) A and C each produce verified inliers strictly above the projective DLT minimum; (3) C verified inliers and source/reference occupied cells are each at least 0.5 of A's; (4) both transforms fit from more than 4 inliers. This is cross-instrument optical robustness, not full multi-modal OHRC/TMC/IIRS validation. Independent accuracy remains NOT VALIDATED. Do not retune.
multimodal_hypothesis: H1-cross-sensor: On the same pair, CLAHE cross-sensor intensity (C) maintains a useful verified correspondence set under OHRC-calibrated vs LROC Scaled-I/F appearance differences without spatial collapse or unstable geometry relative to intensity baseline A. H0-cross-sensor: the appearance adaptation collapses verified quality or spatial distribution. This tests cross-instrument optical appearance, not OHRC/TMC/IIRS multi-modal products (those are not in the current demo dataset).
scale_decision_rule: Scale is SUPPORTED only if: (1) a finite native GSD ratio is reported from ingested OHRC gsd_meters and LROC catalog fallback 0.5 m/px and differs from 1 by more than 5%; (2) A and B each produce verified inliers strictly above the projective DLT minimum; (3) B verified inliers and source/reference occupied cells are each at least 0.5 of A's; (4) both transforms fit from more than 4 inliers; (5) B's scale_policy is common_physical_gsd and observed strides differ from A's or effective GSDs are recorded. Raw match count is not success. Independent accuracy remains NOT VALIDATED. Do not retune.
scale_hypothesis: H1-scale: On pair_02_mid_equatorial, the production coarse-to-fine intensity path maintains a useful verified correspondence set across the real OHRC/LROC native GSD difference, and applying common_physical_gsd matching views (B) does not collapse verified yield, 8x8 occupancy, or transform stability relative to A. H0-scale: the native GSD gap or GSD-normalised views cause collapse or unstable geometry.

evaluate.rmse_meaning: RMSE of stored verification inlier residuals on the points used to fit the transform; this is a fit diagnostic, not accuracy

generate_representation.coordinate_mapping: x_original = x_matching * stride; y_original = y_matching * stride

matcher_held_out_validation.design: k-fold split of verified correspondences; transform refitted on the complement of each fold and scored on the fold itself
matcher_held_out_validation.units: original image pixels (reference frame transfer error)
matcher_held_out_validation.why_not_independent_accuracy: held-out points are matcher-derived and were selected by the same RANSAC consensus as the fitting points, so their errors are correlated with the fit; no surveyed lunar control exists

refine_points.limitation: INDETERMINATE means zero coordinates changed; the frozen ControlPoint contract has no per-point outcome field, so already-optimal cannot be distinguished from no measurable improvement. This is not a successful refinement.

spatial_distribution.limitation: occupied-cell ratio and Clark-Evans R are experiment diagnostics, not proof of uniform coverage of the true OHRC/LROC overlap; overlap is not recomputed from the products
spatial_distribution.uniformity_metric: clark_evans_R = mean_nn / (0.5 * sqrt(image_area / n)); R<1 clustered, R~1 random, R>1 dispersed. No edge correction.

unselected_verified_checkpoints.design: transform fitted from selected control points, scored on verified inliers that were not selected as control points. Checkpoint identities are identical across refinement variants.
unselected_verified_checkpoints.units: original image pixels (reference frame transfer error)
unselected_verified_checkpoints.why_not_independent_accuracy: held-out points are matcher-derived and were selected by the same RANSAC consensus as the fitting points, so their errors are correlated with the fit; no surveyed lunar control exists
